title: So so noted taking app
body: Apple Notes is good for minimalists. It is well designed and gives you what you need. The performance is good. However, the battery drains faster than with other apps, such as OneNote. Also, your iPad gets very hot, especially when you enable the Refined Handwriting and Auto Calculate Math features.
